text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: tenant 'lumen' goes live tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need a tiny CSM playbook (<10m) that covers prefill, jitter, streaming fallback, and a single renewal_risk flag logic. Prefer copy/paste snippets.
Diego (Solutions): Got it. Proposal: 6-step quickhand for CSMs. Keep it action-oriented.
Maya (CS): Love 6 steps. Make sure step #4 captures survey_sent and negative-feedback boolean in the event.
Ellen (SRE): I'll own infra checks and the jitter/retry defaults. Draft steps: 1) confirm healthz green 2) push 3 sample prefill requests 3) enable warm pool for 30m 4) ramp 10/30/100% over 30m 5) watch latency & errors 6) send survey link at +2h.
Priya (PM): For renewal_risk mapping: if any of these true -> high: 7d avg latency > 350ms, 1h error rate > 1.5%, negative feedback count >= 1. Medium if one marginal breach. Low otherwise. We'll wire an alert callback to CS.
Diego (Solutions): Prefill curl we give customers (copyable):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Prefill: 1' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant":"lumen","samples":["Welcome back, how can I help?","Show my orders"]}'
```
Maya (CS): Add a line: "Do not prefill > 800 tokens per user" and ask customers to mark production vs staging.
Ellen (SRE): Healthcheck & jitter snippets: GET /healthz?tenant=lumen must return 200. Jitter policy: base=120ms, jitter=random(0..180ms), max_retries=3. Example pseudo: `sleep(base + rand(0,180)/1000)` between attempts.
Diego (Solutions): Batching guidance (short): interactive paths -> batch target 4, max_latency_target=50ms; async jobs -> batch 16-48. If observed P95 latency rises, flip to small_batch_mode: batch=2, enable_kv_cache=true.
Priya (PM): Streaming fallback: prefer chunked responses. If client or connection drops within 6s, fallback to sync generate with max_tokens=200 and header `X-Redwood-Fallback:stream->sync`. Log fallback_event in telemetry.
Maya (CS): Survey snippet we send in email after 2h: "Quick 3 Qs: correctness, speed, would-recommend (1-5). Link: https://forms.redwood.ai/lumen-postlaunch". Make sure survey_sent:true in event.
Diego (Solutions): Telemetry sample event payload (JSON we recommend):
```json
{"event":"prefill_result","tenant":"lumen","account_risk":"low","prefill_tokens":56,"latency_ms":140,"survey_sent":false}
```
Maya (CS): CSM runbook one-pager should be exactly 6 bullets they can check off. Also include the curl/js snippets and the survey link.
Ellen (SRE): Ownership recap (1-liners): CSM = runbook executor + survey follow-up; Solutions = sample payloads + batching defaults; SRE = healthchecks, jitter, fallback rules; PM = dashboard thresholds + survey mapping.
cs-bot: Alert rule created -> will DM @Maya when renewal_risk != low. :bell:
Ellen (SRE): I'll add the playbook health-check script to /ops/playbooks and set the cs-bot rule. ETA 4h.
Diego (Solutions): I'll publish the one-pager to /docs/cs/lightning-handoff and paste link here. ETA 2h.
Priya (PM): I'll create the dashboard card and webhook to POST /cs/webhook on threshold. ETA 24h.
Maya (CS): Thanks team — once snippets are up I'll paste into the kickoff email. If anything else missing ping me. :white_check_mark:
cs-bot: Deploy check -> preflight OK for 'lumen' (build 2026.03.521). :rocket:
